pulses.name: Inside Keitaro Abuse Part 2: One Platform, Many Threats
pulses.description: This analysis examines how threat actors abuse Keitaro, an advertising performance tracker, for various malicious purposes. The report covers a wide range of threats, including malware delivery, phishing, scams, and illegal content distribution.
